metadata.title: FAFO GRC Pipeline System Security Plan
metadata.remarks: Generated by scripts/generate_ssp.py from frameworks/ssp-implementation.json. Do not edit by hand.

system-characteristics.description: FAFO Inc. (90 people, Series B) runs a health-analytics SaaS entirely on Azure. This system is FAFO's GRC engineering pipeline: it governs every subscription under management group mg-grc-sandbox as code, collects evidence every 6 hours, reports from stored evidence only, and remediates through one approved identity. The federal pilot through a prime contractor requires NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate.

information-types.title: Compliance and audit evidence
information-types.description: Control-test results, role-assignment snapshots, run manifests and reports about FAFO's Azure estate.

authorization-boundary.description: Management group mg-grc-sandbox and every subscription beneath it; the GRC workspace; the evidence store; the Terraform state account; the GitHub repository and its workflows. Customer analytics workloads are governed by this system but are outside its boundary.

users.title: GRC engineer (human operator)
users.remarks: Applies Terraform from a reviewed, saved plan; approves remediation in PRs.

components.title: FAFO GRC Pipeline
components.description: FAFO Inc.'s automated GRC engineering pipeline on Azure: governed hierarchy and policy (stage 01), Defender activation (02), evidence store and collector (03), reporter (04), human-gated enforcement (06) and detection (07), with a CI gate and nightly drift detection.

components.title: FAFO GRC Baseline initiative (Azure Policy)
components.description: Nine policy definitions in one initiative, assigned once at management group mg-grc-sandbox so every current and future subscription inherits them.

components.title: Discovery-first activation
components.description: Azure Resource Graph inventory across the management group; the measured out-of-region gap decides the residency control's effect.

components.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud plans + NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 regulatory initiative
components.description: Baseline Defender plans converged in every subscription under the management group; the built-in 800-53 Rev. 5 initiative assigned at the management group.

components.title: Evidence store (Cosmos DB + WORM Blob)
components.description: Entra-only Cosmos DB (findings, rbac, runs, assessments, mappings) and a storage account with shared keys disabled whose reports container carries a time-based immutability (WORM) policy.

components.title: Evidence collector (Azure Function, managed identity)
components.description: Every 6 hours: discovers subscriptions from its management-group roles, collects Defender assessments, Policy compliance states and role-assignment snapshots, and seals each run with id and content digests.

components.title: Report generators (Azure Function, managed identity)
components.description: Daily POA&M (JSON, XLSX, OSCAL) and SAR + scorecard, built only from completed, fresh, seal-verified runs, published to WORM with a manifest of SHA-256s and verbatim queries.

components.title: Corrective controls and approval gate
components.description: Modify policies on an audit/dry-run/enforce ladder; remediation tasks exist only for control keys a reviewer approved with a ticket in a CODEOWNERS-protected file.

components.title: Remediation identity (user-assigned managed identity)
components.description: The single named identity through which every automated fix flows; custom role without listKeys, regenerateKey or delete.

components.title: Activity Log routing and tripwire alert rules
components.description: Activity Log of every governed subscription routed to the GRC workspace; four scheduled KQL tripwires (kql/) evaluated every 15 minutes.

components.title: Compliance gate and drift detection (GitHub Actions + OPA)
components.description: Every PR: fmt, validate, tflint, checkov, OPA unit tests, gate fixtures, pytest, gitleaks; same-repo PRs: real plan per stage through 12 OPA rules with a read-only identity. Nightly: terraform plan -detailed-exitcode per stage, drift opens an issue.

components.title: Terraform state backend
components.description: Entra-only, versioned, soft-deleted, change-feed, delete-locked state account; hardening re-verified by stage 07 postconditions on every plan.

control-implementation.description: How FAFO's GRC pipeline implements its tailored NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate baseline. Every statement names the component, and the component names the code that does it.

by-components.description: fafo-cosmos-no-local-auth audits Cosmos DB accounts that accept key auth, so every data-plane account is an Entra identity that can be managed and attributed.
Role-assignment snapshots (rbac container) record every account's access per subscription per run, the evidence for account reviews.
kql/off-hours-admin-changes.kql alerts on human accounts used outside the change window.
cge-deny-public-blob denies storage accounts that allow anonymous blob access.
Defender assessment 'Storage account public access should be disallowed' is collected and mapped.
Defender assessments for storage network restriction (VNet rules / private link) are collected and mapped to AC-4.
The collector can write evidence but holds no data action on the reports container.
The reporter can read evidence and create reports but holds no Cosmos write and no Azure Resource Manager role.
Only the remediation identity holds a write role on resources, and only storage properties.
Custom role fafo-storage-baseline-remediator: storage read/write and resource group read; listKeys, regenerateKey and delete excluded.
Gate rules TF-IAM-001/002 block Owner, Contributor, User Access Administrator and RBAC Administrator grants and wildcard custom roles.
kql/remediator-out-of-lane.kql alerts on any operation by the remediation identity outside its lane.
fafo-audit-subscription-owner flags every Owner assignment at subscription scope.
The SAR's privileged-access section counts privileged and standing subscription Owner assignments per subscription from stored snapshots.
Role-assignment snapshots every 6 hours give each privilege review a dated, sealed population.
The SAR lists standing subscription Owners for review from the run it reports on.
kql/remediator-out-of-lane.kql and kql/keyvault-secret-reads-non-pipeline.kql log and alert on privileged-function use.
90-day immutability on reports; per-run history kept in findings and rbac; soft delete on blobs and containers.
DeployIfNotExists policies make log generation self-enforcing for storage and Key Vault.
cge-dine-storage-diagnostics and fafo-dine-keyvault-audit-logs deploy diagnostic settings to the GRC workspace where missing.
Administrative, Security, Policy and Alert Activity Log categories are routed for every governed subscription.
Four scheduled KQL tripwires review audit records every 15 minutes and email the GRC owner.
Reports container WORM policy, CanNotDelete locks on Cosmos and evidence storage, shared keys disabled, data-plane access logged.
Gate rules TF-EVD-001/002 block deleting or replacing the evidence plane and shortening WORM retention.
The daily SAR assesses every mapped control from the latest completed run, with the queries that produced each number.
The daily POA&M lists every open finding with severity, first-seen date from history and a scheduled completion date (FedRAMP timelines), in JSON, XLSX and OSCAL.
Continuous monitoring: collection every 6 hours across every subscription in scope.
Defender assessments and the 800-53 regulatory initiative provide continuous platform assessment.
The initiative is the baseline configuration, defined as code and inherited by scope.
The residency baseline's effect is derived from the measured gap, so the baseline never outruns the estate.
Every change is a PR through the compliance gate; enforcement, policy, crosswalk and workflows are CODEOWNERS-protected; drift detection makes unreviewed change visible nightly.
Remediation is approved as code: a control key plus change ticket in approvals.auto.tfvars.
kql/unexpected-writer.kql alerts on out-of-band changes by unexpected principals.
Branch protection with required Code Owner review and required gate checks on main; the CI identity is read-only.
Corrective Modify policies (cge-fix-public-blob, fafo-fix-min-tls) restore mandatory settings through the remediation identity.
fafo-storage-min-tls12 and fafo-allowed-locations define mandatory configuration settings.
cge-require-env-tag-rg keeps resource groups attributable to an environment and owner.
The Resource Graph inventory lists every resource under the management group outside approved regions.
fafo-keyvault-purge-protection audits vaults whose keys and secrets could be permanently destroyed.
State is versioned with soft delete, so every prior state version is recoverable.
fafo-cosmos-no-local-auth: Cosmos DB access by Entra identity only.
Evidence Cosmos DB has local auth disabled; evidence storage has shared keys disabled and OAuth by default.
Defender's 'MFA on accounts with owner permissions' assessment is collected and mapped.
No stored credentials: managed identities and OIDC federation everywhere; the one Y1 runtime key is a ticketed, expiring exception (RISK-0001).
gitleaks runs on every PR; TF-STG-002 blocks shared-key storage without an unexpired exception.
This SSP is generated from frameworks/ssp-implementation.json by scripts/generate_ssp.py, so the plan changes only through reviewed commits.
Defender for Cloud plans run vulnerability and configuration assessment in every governed subscription.
23 OPA unit tests and the pytest suite run on every PR; the gate must block a known-bad plan and pass a known-good one.
fafo-allowed-locations restricts resources to approved US regions.
The out-of-region gap is measured across the management group before Deny is armed.
fafo-keyvault-purge-protection keeps key material from being purged inside its retention window.
fafo-storage-min-tls12 requires TLS 1.2 cipher suites for storage in transit.
Evidence at rest in Cosmos DB and Blob storage is encrypted by the platform (platform-managed keys, RISK-0003).
cge-deny-public-blob removes anonymous public access to storage.
Defender storage public-access and network-restriction assessments are collected and mapped.
Defender's secure-transfer assessment is collected and mapped.
TF-STG-004 blocks storage that allows HTTP.
fafo-storage-min-tls12 audits storage below TLS 1.2.
fafo-fix-min-tls sets minimumTlsVersion to TLS1_2 through an approved remediation task.
cge-fix-public-blob remediates the public-access flaw on existing accounts through an approved task.
Tripwires monitor the Activity Log and Key Vault audit events of every governed subscription.
Storage diagnostics routed to the workspace by DeployIfNotExists.
Every run is sealed with SHA-256 digests over its document ids and contents, per container.
Reports recompute the seals and refuse to publish from altered evidence; each report manifest records file SHA-256s.
Integrity is checked on every report execution, and scripts/reproduce_report.py re-checks any past report on demand.
